title: equivalent content both official languages
rule: Equivalent content in both official languages — professionally translated; Canadian EN/FR conventions; bilingual images, multimedia and transcripts (or equivalent information in both languages). Not a “summary in the other language.” Dual-cite USWDS language selector (full equivalent translations) vs Canada Official-Language keep-place toggle — two jobs; this row is content equivalence, not the toggle control.

citation.source: Canada.ca — Designing content; Designing content for Canada.ca

pass_when: EN and FR are equivalent professional translations, including media/transcripts or equivalent information.
fail_when: Other language is only a summary, or media exists in one official language only with no equivalent.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Keep-place language toggle as this row; USWDS 2-vs-3+ selector as this row.
